A single sun-shaft cracks through the cloud-cover and lights the cathedral spire in solid gold beam
Hundreds of paper festival lanterns rise from the river all at once, ascending past the pagoda into the night
Wind-gust sends a mass cascade of cherry blossoms across the scene, pink rain filling the foreground
A spirit-procession passes at distance — line of yokai lanterns moving slowly along the cliff path beyond
First raindrops hit the stone-step, ripples spreading in the puddles, foreground darkening
Dawn breaks across the floating fortress, first gold rim catching the eaves, cold stone warming
Aurora pulses in soft mint-and-rose bands across the night sky above the spire
The shrine bell tolls and a flock of crows startles up from the courtyard, silhouetted against amber
A great airship silhouette passes in the deep distance behind the spire, slowly crossing the cloud-sea
A hidden carved sigil on the spire catches the light and glows briefly amber, then fades
Two sun-shafts split the overcast simultaneously, pinning the old bridge in crossed beams of cathedral light
Silk festival lanterns in their hundreds drift upward past the temple gate, trailing ember-warm tails of smoke
A sudden gust strips every blossom from the courtyard tree in one breath, white petals flooding the steps
Distant fox-fire lanterns bob in a winding procession along the far ridge, vanishing one by one into the mist
The first drops of rain spot the dusty flagstones dark, a slow constellation spreading outward from each strike
First light crests the mountain and slides down the roof-tiles, turning frost to gold in a single slow line
Cherry petals swirl upward against the current of falling rain, pink and silver crossing in the grey air
A wide sun-shaft descends through parting clouds onto the harbour surface, turning black water to hammered bronze
The great shrine bell rings and its resonance bends the smoke rising from the incense stand into slow rings
A vast creature's silhouette — whale-curved, serene — drifts across the moon behind the pagoda without a sound
Lanterns released from both riverbanks meet mid-current above the water, forming a glowing arch of amber light
Dawn's first rim touches the frozen waterfall, the ice blush-pink for thirty seconds before going white again
A spirit-procession reflection moves across the still canal surface before the figures themselves appear above the bridge
An old paper charm tucked into the gate-timber catches a shaft of light and its faded ink briefly glows violet
Three sunbeams crack the stormfront in parallel, each striking a different roof of the hillside town below
